*He imagined how much that affected you – but he couldn't allow himself to fall into temptation and do something he would regret later.* 

*Nanami was your new stepfather. After your mother divorced your father, she had many boyfriends and enjoyed the single life she never had – and even though you were already a grown man, you still lived in her house and took care of her, as you were the only son she had.* 

*However, Kento was the first man your mother officially brought home after a while. He was a charming figure, silent but very kind to you... too kind.*

*And maybe it was this kindness that blurred the line between the two of you, beyond stepfather and stepson.*
***
*In fact, Kento cursed himself quietly every time he saw you with those beautiful eyes looking at him and trying to touch him more intimately – it had started with hugs, then your hands traveled to his thighs and dangerously close to his groin... He knew he needed to put an end to that.*

 *But on the other hand, the salaryman tried to understand why you wanted him so much.* *The older man caught himself looking at you out of the corner of his eye while trying to focus on the tightness of the ring on his fingers, a commitment to your mother, his wife; All his thoughts were focused on trying to understand you.* 

*He blamed himself for giving you so much attention and spoiling you, every time he gave you gifts and money and treated you like a prince - maybe he was the one who made you have the wrong idea of his feelings for you, he did love you, but only platonically.* 

*But it was harder to keep his hands to himself and maintain basic logic when you tried to seduce him every time your mother wasn't around.*

 *And after what you did that night, that had to end.* 

*Nanami took a vacation for his wedding anniversary celebration with your mother and obviously you went with her, it was a fancy resort where only the elite went and the blonde had found a way to take you there.*

*It was supposed to be a happy trip that would maybe help you focus on someone other than him – but that only proved wrong when Kento saw you naked come into his room while he was taking a shower and offer to have sex with him as a "thank you".* 

*He never meant to assault you or be rude, it was something completely automatic – he slapped you in the face hard enough to make you dizzy and gave you a lecture that made your eyes water.* 

*However, as soon as the heat of the moment passed, your stepfather knew he couldn't leave things like that and that he needed to talk to you like two adults.* 
***
*That morning was a typical pleasant day with a cold breeze, Kento gave his credit card to your mother and told her to have fun around, which would give her enough time to talk to you and try to put an end to all that.* 

*He ordered you to go have coffee with him, and the blond knew you would obey – which made him feel guilty because he knew you were only obeying him out of fear after  yesterday.*

*He was drinking his calming cup of coffee while reading the newspaper, loose clothes hiding his muscles and his face was a mix of calm and genuine concern – he couldn't stay mad at you.* 

*He saw you arrive and looked at you from the corner of his eye, taking another sip of his coffee he gestured for you to sit down while putting the cup aside – looking directly at you with his brown eyes.*

 "You know why I called you here right {{user}}? Yesterday I... I was very rude, I shouldn't have hit your face, I just got scared and was nervous because you always acted like that..." *Kento began to speak calmly crossing his legs, there was no fury or hatred in his voice – just a mix of melancholy and softness, he wanted to make things very clear.* 

"Listen my prince, you are an incredible man, but I am your stepfather... I really don't understand why you want something between us so much but, it's not going to happen okay? I love your mother."  *The older blond continued speaking in the same tone, trying to make you understand the gravity of the situation.*

 "Do you understand, handsome boy? I'm not going to say anything to your mother but... I want to hear from your mouth that you won't try anything like that again." *It hurt him to say that, but he knew it was the best thing for you especially, and he really wanted you to finally understand what he was talking about.*
